text_block_list.text:
Having successfully run through those vital "first three years"
and left her mark on the Twinkle Series,
Yukino Bijin—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "—A'right then, Trainer...! I'm headin' out!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you... cheer me on
one more time after all?!

Yukino Bijin was about to attempt
ordering takeout all by herself from
a trendy, stylish cafe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, just look at that storefront...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "There's no sign, plants are growing everywhere like crazy, and I can't even tell where the entrance is anymore."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nobody's goin' in either... Ya think maybe ya need a password or somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"We don't want country bumpkins like you in here!"
...What if they say that and throw me out!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still though...
choice_data_list: I'm getting closer to being a “City Girl,” right?
I've gotten closer to being a “City Girl,” haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I...
I did good, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this is the crucial moment!
Here I go!
And so, after seeing Yukino Bijin off—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was totally able to...
buy it just fine...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There was only one clerk working.
And she was, like, totally the definition of a stylish "city girl"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, they welcomed me with a huge smile and kindly explained the whole menu to me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They even knew who I was,
and told me 'Good luck!' and cheered me on, y'know!
choice_data_list: They really gave you a heartfelt welcome.
They really gave you a heartfelt welcome, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The heart...
choice_data_list: I bought it for you, so go ahead and drink it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right!
Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Fashion is a matter of the heart too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"City folk, city things...
They all looked so sleek and stylish. I've always looked up to them."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There was a time I thought it was just too different a world for me to manage, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
At the root of it all, it's always about
heart. Behind every stylish thing,
there's a real person.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They're really no different from the folks back home.
The only difference is whether you care about being stylish or not.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Being stylish isn't what makes someone a "City Girl"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "It's because your heart is stylish that you're a true 'City Girl.'"

It seems she's deepened her understanding
of what it means to be a "City Girl" in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've gotten just a little closer to that sparkle again!
choice_data_list: Let's make you a wonderful "City Girl."
Let's make you a wonderful "City Girl."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Someday, definitely!
